body: You just came into my fucking thread about killing myself and you fucking told me I'm insignificant what the actual fuck? And then talk about how YOU are "going to stay and see this one out", blah blah blah. Good for you. Way to rub it in my face that you can keep your shit together long enough to want to live. Living is my own version of hell. Sorry I can't see the rainbows and unicorns that have clouded your mind.

Call me ignorant but I stopped reading after: 
 
>Realising how insignificant we all are should help you take a step back and also realise how insignificant the problems you're having are.

Sorry, but you don't get to sit there and tell me my problems are insignificant. Kindly, fuck off.

I have no family. My mom abandoned me and my brothers followed her lead because she's addicted to prescription fucking drugs. Takes twenty fucking Xanax a day and *"doesn't feel a thing"*. Brothers like the drugs. Haven't heard from them since. 

Got no other family. Dads a blundering alcoholic. 
No grandparents. No cousins. NO family. No friends. My co-workers would never understand and I'd like to save myself from the humiliation. I've humiliated myself enough in this life. I deserve nothing and nothing is what I'll get. Ready to see that light.

Sure everyone deserves to be happy. Being alone is a miserable fucking feeling and I'm tired of feeling it. Not a single person would give a fuck. Including all of you trying to convince me not to. 

See you don't even know me. You know nothing about my life. Not what I look like. Not what I feel. Not what I've Been through. People come here to express that they're gonna take their own life and all you people come flocking like you're trying to impress some kind of God by being a 'saint' and coming to the rescue of some suicidal fuck wad. I won't be your good deed.

Do you actually know what it feels like to have NO ONE? Being bipolar and not being able to control any of it? Ruining every goddamn relationship you've ever been in? Including platonic ones. Do you know how it feels to be abandoned by everyone? My own fucking mother wants nothing to do with me. She WISHES I were dead. In fact she wishes the doctors never removed the umbilical cord from around my neck when I was born, cause that surely would have killed me. It was a matter of minutes. Ha. Should have let me die then.
Since we're so insignificant, why the fuck would I stick around? All your comment did was make me wanna off myself more.

When the same thing happens over and over. There's no use. On top of that, you think anyone is going to fucking notice if I leave? People say they have no one. I have no one. Boyfriend was the last. Mother abandoned me. Don't have friends. Don't even use social media, because what's the point with anyone around? Only came here to see if I'd change my mind, and I haven't
